name: little griefs
source:
Remi, your new psychopomp apprentice, disappears abruptly after the day's mission, so you decide to go looking for them. When you finally track them down, you discover that they are at a familiar place...

[from [url=https://smokemirror.itch.io/little-griefs]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雷米，你的新精神派学徒，在一天的任务结束后突然消失，所以你决定去寻找他们。当你最终找到他们时，你发现他们在一个熟悉的地方……

[来自[url=https://smokemirror.itch.io/little-griefs]itch.io[/url]]
